rows.ARS: Exhibition name: A Whiter Shade of Pale
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin A. Pearce (United Kingdom, 2006).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Pocock's Nurseries/Pocock's Roses in 2006.
rows.Bloom: White and light pink. Flowers white with a touch of pink shading. Strong fragrance. Average diameter 3.5". Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium. Medium, semi-glossy foliage.

Height: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Vigorous. Protect tender new spring growth from hard freezes that may cause canker, die-back and death of the plant. . Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood..
